head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Broader open-source writer/read-acceptance review and local wire/test crosswalk, with a focused unresolved HATCH group-47 derived-zero profile. No code or test changes.

crosswalk.finding: A reported AutoCAD 2027 strict DXF rejection on AC1024 output; the Sep-23 comment says an AutoCAD-saved sample has group 47 on derived HATCH paths (92=7) and TrueView asks for group 47 when it is removed. The comment does not disclose the numeric pixel-size value.
crosswalk.disposition: Current source only emits group 47 for nonzero pixelSize; the local generated test has an associative 92=7 zero case and expects absence. Whether that contradicts the reported artifact depends on its undisclosed numeric value. The current mutable upstream sample inspected previously does not contain the reported 92=7 path, and the issue comment did not bind historical sample/output hashes. Treat as PROFILE_CONFLICT / REPRODUCTION_REQUIRED, not a confirmed defect.

crosswalk.finding: The report identifies an invalid CLASS 92/93 sequence and missing AC1024 DIMSTYLE table-header fields.
crosswalk.local_owner: src/drw_classes.cpp DRW_Class::write; src/libdxfrw.cpp writeTables; tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp DIMSTYLE header census
crosswalk.disposition: Local CLASS writer emits the expected ordered modern fields without 92/93. AC1024 DIMSTYLE header code 71 and per-row 340 references are already asserted by generated tests; no duplicate change is planned.

crosswalk.finding: The reporter describes silent 3DSOLID/REGION DXF loss, including nested solid-only blocks and INSERT instances, on ACadSharp 3.4.9.
crosswalk.local_owner: Existing PAR-59/PAR-07 modeler output disposition, block/INSERT closure, and transactional refusal owners
crosswalk.disposition: Already represented in the plan. Issue and unmerged writer branch are not released peer capability evidence and do not establish a libdxfrw defect.

crosswalk.finding: A no-op DWG writer route reportedly required AutoCAD RECOVER and lost layouts/graph data despite passing project tests; maintainer later reported source/output semantic and AcDs comparisons after a fix.
crosswalk.local_owner: Existing composed independent-reader/native-audit and source-identity/owner closure gates
crosswalk.disposition: Reinforces separation of unit/same-codec tests from native audit and semantic disposition. Peer-authored report not independently rerun.

crosswalk.finding: Their public disclosures separate class maturity, read/write direction, ignored missing-sample tests, and bounded ACIS behavior.
crosswalk.local_owner: Existing peer intake/evidence ledger and ACIS carrier-versus-semantics gates
crosswalk.disposition: Track declared support, evaluated/test-run status, partial/recovered outcomes, native acceptance, graph closure, carrier retention, and geometry as separate columns. No claim promotion.

plan_delta.conditional_resolution: Pin historical ACadSharp #1253 DWG/AutoCAD-DXF source pair and hashes; if unavailable, record NOT_RESOLVED_EXTERNAL and continue. If confirmed, update only the existing generated HATCH selector and justified HATCH predicate; keep MPOLYGON separate.
